reason: Twenty-two thousand is more than a month and a half of what my whole household earns, and the EMI would eat almost a sixth of every month. My wife and I wash by hand and it gets done, so I cannot put that money into a machine when seed, fertiliser and school fees come first.
objection: Will a cold wash in a small drum really get the mud and sweat out of farm clothes, or will we end up scrubbing them by hand again after paying all that money? And water here only comes when the borewell has power, so a battery in the machine does not help if the tank is empty.
would_change_my_mind: If the price came down to around ₹10,000 with a small EMI I could stop after a bad harvest, and a neighbour showed me it cleaning real muddy field clothes.
